verdict.rationale: Resend documents React Email as a first-party, vendor-maintained framework for authoring emails as code, with templates sent via the API, and this is corroborated by hands-on community feedback praising the React templating experience. Emails-as-code with version-controllable React components is a core, well-documented workflow. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of MJML support or another equivalent maintained framework beyond React Email, and no direct mention of git/version-control workflow guidance.
